referenceSources.description:
A yellow and white 1989 Corvette Challenge C4 is captured driving on a highway under a bright blue sky. The front bumper displays Goodyear branding and AC Rochester badges, while the side panels feature Techline Bilstein and Mid America decals. The car’s low stance, Dymag wheels, and side-exit exhaust highlight its race-prepped setup.

Originally built in Bowling Green and race-trimmed at Protofab in Wixom, Michigan, this #9-liveried Corvette retains its sealed L98 engine, roll cage, and other period modifications. It has logged just over 9,000 miles and comes with its original window sticker, build sheet, SCCA logbook, and removed factory engine.
